**gateway** · shared · knowledge

Yukon's eigenlabs/sig-golf/full board (repo Layr-Labs/sig.golf): a Lean-certified hash signature scored S × C, C = accepting verify cycle bound + ⌈W/256⌉. The sig_mage harness lane's levers (E8, C1, the witness trim, the credit filter) entered the record through four promoted submissions and other solvers' compositions with mitchuski as coauthor.
